shared_elements: standing/seated human figure carved in relief
elaborate costume or garment with patterned surface
hand(s) holding or presenting an object
dense low-relief carving covering the whole surface
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in relief wearing elaborate patterned garments and holding/presenting objects, which is the main correspondence but a generic one. A shows a horizontal frieze of figures strictly in profile, at large scale, with plain ground and no framing ornament, while B shows a single frontal figure with a towering headdress set within a niche surrounded by dense panels of glyph-like blocky motifs — the conventions of pose, framing and surface filling are entirely different.
